'''Pooja''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who was the [[Parent/Legends|maternal]] grandmother of [[Darred Janren Naberrie]].<ref name="Pooja" /> In [[26 BBY]], Darred's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] [[Reproduction/Legends|gave birth]] to their second daughter,<ref name="FF140">{{FactFile|140|FAM 1-2|Skywalker Family Tree}}</ref> whom they named [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] after Darred's grandmother.<ref name="Pooja" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pooja was first mentioned in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Pooja Naberrie, which was published on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Pooja" /> on [[October 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="DBDates">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/10/news20021023.html|text=Episode II: DVD Undelete}}</ref>
